definitions.gloss: art book, collection of paintings or illustrations
definitions.explanation: A book containing a collection of paintings, drawings, or illustrations by one or more artists. Can range from fine art reproductions to anime/manga illustration collections.

examples.japanese: モネの{画集|がしゅう}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a Monet art book.

examples.japanese: {好|す}きなイラストレーターの{画集|がしゅう}が{出版|しゅっぱん}された。
examples.english: An art book by my favorite illustrator was published.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}のショップで{浮世絵|うきよえ}の{画集|がしゅう}を{手|て}に{取|と}った。
examples.english: I picked up an ukiyo-e art book at the museum shop.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for any bound collection of visual art. In Japan, {画集|がしゅう} covers both traditional fine art reproductions and modern illustration/anime art books. The word {写真集|しゃしんしゅう} is the equivalent for photography collections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画集|がしゅう}を{出版|しゅっぱん}する: to publish an art book
- {画集|がしゅう}を{眺|なが}める: to browse through an art book
- {風景|ふうけい}{画集|がしゅう}: landscape painting collection
- イラスト{画集|がしゅう}: illustration art book
